notes.title: Gun Dealer Simulator: Quick Tips
notes.content:
Welcome to the Trade. Gun Dealer Simulator  - v0.0.3r is available now.
Before you dive into the risky business of arms dealing—whether you choose to stay on the legal side or take your chances on the black market—here’s a list of quick, spoiler-free tips to help you build your operation, earn a reputation, and survive in a world where every deal counts.


Learn to Use Your Phone
Press C to open your in-game phone — it’s your main control center for:

Managing black market deals (especially at night)

Always keep empty boxes on hand to fulfill delivery deals that appear during the night

Skipping time to the next day when you have nothing left to do

The phone is essential. Many systems in the game won’t function unless you interact through it.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692044/9f5dbfd2838ea2462b9dce65090df9ae8e98393f.jpg"]


Use the Map and Radar to Navigate
Press Tab or M to open the map and waypoint system. These will help you:

Track seller locations scattered across the map

Set destination points

Navigate more efficiently, especially when using your vehicle

Without waypoints, it’s easy to waste time wandering or missing key vendors.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692044/9a88946ea01048fb32c760f0fd2f1a5f5a559a96.jpg"]


Secure a Store and Buy a Warehouse
Early in the game, you’ll need to rent your store to begin official operations. After that, invest in a local warehouse to:

Store large amounts of weapons or equipment

Avoid clutter and better manage your inventory flow


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692044/a26d46a511c597a97be555145e4186a8ea418fe8.jpg"]


Manage Electricity or Lose Everything
Your store depends on power. If the electricity is off, your:

Doors won’t open

Lights won’t turn on

Computers and vending machines won’t function

Always check your power if something stops working unexpectedly.

                   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692044/522d3ad34def65d6313c0458112660696a78cc66.png"]




Keep Your Store Clean
Trash reduce your store reputation, which directly affects customer behavior. Use a trash bucket to:

Collect multiple pieces of garbage at once

Recycle them quickly

Keep the store attractive to new clients

A clean store is a trusted store.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692044/d760ed32150d5ddae543e289b6d732862b52b53b.jpg"]


Use Your Car, But Don’t Forget Gas
You’ll eventually gain access to a vehicle, which helps speed up travel across the map. However:

The car requires fuel — no gas, no movement

Refueling regularly will save you time and frustration

Many vendors are spread out, so the car is a major quality-of-life upgrade

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692044/f06db7d0f9cea359d0efbc408f8d9ee00f246764.jpg"]


Watch for Nighttime Deals
Black market arms deals are more common at night, often with higher risk and reward. Be prepared:

Keep extra empty boxes on hand to package items quickly

Manage your store heat and reputation, as illegal deals can draw unwanted attention

Use the phone to view or skip nighttime activity

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692044/b151b676a5d79a5bbcdedecf6adea340241709d9.jpg"]


Not Every Customer is Safe
Some customers will:

Use fake licenses

Attempt to steal from your store

Always verify documentation. Stay alert. And consider installing upgrades or safety measures when available.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692044/792485cf6e4a2d7d95b0b702964e3fc9106e2007.jpg"]


Reputation Matters
Your store reputation affects everything:

A low reputation means customers will avoid your shop

A high reputation brings better clients and more business

Cleanliness, deal success, and customer treatment all contribute to reputation

If no one’s entering your store, check your reputation score.



                   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692044/522d3ad34def65d6313c0458112660696a78cc66.png"]




Handle Your Finances Wisely
Money management is critical. You can:

Take out loans to stay afloat during rough patches

Pay weekly bills on time via ATM machines (or face penalties)

Gamble your profits at the casino — but be warned, luck can turn fast

Overspending or ignoring bills will quickly lead to failure.


Licenses Unlock Progression
Without proper licenses, you can’t:

Purchase new items

Expand your store

Access key features in the economy

Visit the Omni Permit at shop PC and prioritize unlocking essential features early. A locked-down dealer is a broke dealer.


Final Advice
Gun Dealer Simulator is about strategy, risk management, and operational control. It’s not just about selling — it’s about how, when, and to whom you sell.

Use your tools

Understand each system

Don’t rush expansion

And always keep an eye on your reputation and balance sheet

Master these basics, and you’ll avoid early frustration — and possibly discover just how far your empire can grow.
